transcript.text:
Here is the full sequence of API calls to create, activate, and query results for a certification campaign in ISC.

---

## Step 0: Authenticate (get an access token)

```
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/oauth/token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type=client_credentials&client_id={clientId}&client_secret={clientSecret}
```

Store the returned `access_token` and pass it as `Authorization: Bearer {access_token}` on every subsequent call.

---

## Step 1: Create the campaign

```
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "name": "Q3 Manager Access Review",
  "description": "Quarterly review of all manager-certified access",
  "type": "MANAGER",
  "deadline": "2026-08-31T23:59:59.999Z"
}
```

For a search-based campaign (e.g. Identities type), add a `filter` object describing your query. For a Source Owner campaign, add `sourceOwnerCampaignInfo` with the relevant source IDs.

The response body contains the new campaign's `id`. Save it.

---

## Step 2: Activate the campaign

Once you've previewed and confirmed the campaign, activate it:

```
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns/{campaignId}/activate
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
Content-Type: application/json

{}
```

This moves the campaign from `STAGED` to `ACTIVE` and notifies reviewers.

---

## Step 3: Pull results while the campaign is underway

**Option A — get available report types for the campaign:**

```
GET https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns/{campaignId}/reports
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
```

**Option B — run a specific report (e.g. certification results):**

```
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns/{campaignId}/reports/{reportType}/run
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
```

Common `reportType` values include `CAMPAIGN_COMPOSITION_REPORT` and `CERTIFICATION_DECISION_REPORT`.

**Option C — list the individual certifications (reviewer-level decisions):**

```
GET https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/certifications?campaignId={campaignId}
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
```

This returns each reviewer's certification, including their decisions (approve/revoke) per access item, and whether they have signed off.

---

## Summary of call order

| # | Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|--------|------|---------|
| 1 | POST | `/oauth/token` | Get bearer token |
| 2 | POST | `/v3/campaigns` | Create campaign |
| 3 | POST | `/v3/campaigns/{id}/activate` | Activate campaign |
| 4 | GET | `/v3/campaigns/{id}/reports` | List available reports |
| 5 | GET | `/v3/certifications` | Query reviewer decisions |
